name_reason: Already conformant: fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> with domain=graphics(FIGANI pose-loop) implied by descriptor. 'step' accurately captures the per-frame state-advance role; 'figani_pose_animation' names the subject. No Ghidra address residue. Confirmed by 3 callers (spell-cast/special-attack/ch30-ending) all using it as the central per-frame pose-state advance.
purpose: Per-frame state stepper for a free-running FIGANI pose-loop: blits the current pose into dst_buf, advances the two module-global counters (pose index x sub-frame), and auto-wraps to the start when the last pose finishes or when palette_op==0 (explicit rewind).
logic_summary: if palette_op!=0: blit current pose via fd2_blit_indexed_sprite(figani_data, pose_idx, dst_buf, dst_stride, palette_op); subframe_idx++; if subframe_idx < pose_block.sub_count (pose_block = figani_data + *(int32*)(figani_data+8+pose_idx*4), sub_count at +6) return (still inside pose); else pose_idx++; if pose_idx < figani_data[+0] (pose count) { subframe_idx=0; return } (advance to next pose). Fall-through (palette_op==0 OR pose_idx ran past last pose): pose_idx=0; subframe_idx=0 (rewind both). __CHK(0x1c) stack-probe prologue is compiler-injected.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_step_figani_pose_animation(uint32 figani_data, uint32 palette_op, uint32 dst_buf, uint32 dst_stride)

params.name: figani_data
params.semantics: Base pointer of the FIGANI animation stream. Read for pose count at +0, per-pose metadata-block offset at +8+pose_idx*4 (relative to stream base), and the pose's sub-frame count at pose_block+6; forwarded to fd2_blit_indexed_sprite as the sprite atlas.
params.reason: Accurately names the FIGANI stream base; no address residue.

params.name: palette_op
params.semantics: Blit-mode / palette-blend value forwarded verbatim to fd2_blit_indexed_sprite (0xFFFFFFFF=passthrough, >0xFF=translucent blend, <=0xFF=silhouette). A zero value is the explicit 'rewind to start' sentinel that skips blitting and resets both counters. Callers pass 0 (rewind), 0xFFFFFFFF (passthrough), or a computed blend (e.g. loop*0x100+base).
params.reason: Name matches its dual role (blit/palette mode + 0=rewind sentinel); no address residue.

params.name: dst_buf
params.semantics: Destination composite work buffer that the current pose is blitted into (callers pass the per-frame scratch base, e.g. work_buf+0x4ba0 or work_buf).
params.reason: Accurate destination-buffer name; no address residue.

params.name: dst_stride
params.semantics: Destination row stride in bytes passed through to fd2_blit_indexed_sprite (callers pass 0x280 for the wide composite or 0x140 for full-frame).
params.reason: Accurate stride name; no address residue. (Type differs from Ghidra's byte* but that is a non-naming signature concern, out of scope for this stage.)

returns.semantics: No return value; side effects are the pose blit into dst_buf and the updates to the two module-global counters.
